hookups.source: https://www.co.rockbridge.va.us/272/Facilities ('All sites have a fire ring, picnic table, water and electricity'; 'Camping Fees include water and electricity hookups'; amperage not stated), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Sites are available to accommodate most all sizes of recreational vehicles or tents (some are pull-through).' No length is published; the 40 ft came from note prose with no operator source.

facilities.source: https://www.co.rockbridge.va.us/272/Facilities ('Comfort stations with individual showers, dressing rooms, and laundry rooms'; 'Disposal dumping station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'Regular season reservations are accepted with deposit beginning April 1. Guests will need to register at the park headquarters.' Cash, money orders or checks only; no credit cards. Campers must be set up by 9 p.m. Superintendent's Office 540-463-4164.
The county page gives a 'Golden Age Passport' (federal senior pass) rate for trailers: $30 against the $40 camper rate.

discounts.source: https://www.co.rockbridge.va.us/272/Facilities ('Golden Age Passport discounts for trailers are $30 per night'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Rockbridge County's own page: 53 sites, all with water and electricity, some pull-throughs, reservations with deposit from April 1, showers/laundry/dump, Golden Age Passport discount. Cleared max_rig_ft 40 (note-derived; county says only 'most all sizes'). Rates ($40 campers, $35 tents, $30 Golden Age) are undated on the page, so fees not written. Amperage, campground season dates (the page lists park hours only) not stated; season left as recorded.
